description: This file is a shell script that implements tests for git conflict scenarios during checkout operations. It verifies behavior when files, directories, and symlinks conflict with git checkout commands, utilizing functions like git update-index, git write-tree, git read-tree, and git checkout-index. It also includes helper functions for displaying filesystem and git index/tree states.

methods.name: show_files
methods.description: Displays the current filesystem and git index/tree structures for debugging purposes.
